title: Launch Commitments
creator: ManishModak / Outside_Taro_9886
summary: Rust token-factory template and CLI for fixed-supply, ownerless tokens with allocations locked through Ootle Lockbox until a chosen epoch. The November 12 creator announcement links a mainnet launch page; the reviewed README does not include a deployment receipt, so this listing documents the source without placing it in the live-mainnet collection. The template fixes its fee and destinations at build time; the README gives a 2,500 TARI mainnet fee example. Allocation labels are creator-declared: locks do not establish team identity or ownership of the remaining supply. The recording is a README walkthrough at revision bd8cf1f, not a token launch. MIT source; tari_template_lib 0.38. No wallet, transaction or third-party code was used for this review.
cardSummary: Explore fixed-supply token launches that combine immutable issuer rules with epoch-based allocation locks through Ootle Lockbox.
cardStatus: Source code · Allocations locked until epoch
publicationBasis: Public creator announcement in r/tari; creator describes a November MVP entry. Listing is not a contest eligibility or judging decision.
